notes: UX copy for the three-tier display. Tier 1 = `label` (a warning-sign name, 1–3 words, shown as a chip or hover tag). Tier 2 = `why` (≤ 12 words: the single most pointed reason it is flagged, shown on hover). Tier 3 = the finding's full `explain`, mechanism glossary, evidence and `tip` (shown on click). Keys are finding ids; `tracker.*` and `ai.*` fall back to prefixes. Edit copy here, not in code.

rhetoric.strawman_markers.label: Straw man
rhetoric.strawman_markers.why: Opponents' view restated to be easy to beat.

rhetoric.whataboutism.label: Whataboutism
rhetoric.whataboutism.why: Changes the subject instead of answering.

rhetoric.thought_terminating.label: Discussion-ender

rhetoric.false_precision_stats.label: Unsourced statistic

rhetoric.euphemism_corporate.label: Euphemism

rhetoric.cherry_pick_markers.why: Big % changes depend on the window chosen.

emotional.fear_lexicon.why: Threat words raise arousal and shorten deliberation.

emotional.tribal_labels.label: Us vs them
emotional.tribal_labels.why: Sorts you into a team so you stop weighing arguments.

emotional.dehumanizing.label: Dehumanizing
emotional.dehumanizing.why: People described as pests or floods.

emotional.guilt_trip.label: Guilt trip
emotional.guilt_trip.why: You're made responsible unless you comply.

emotional.sensational_formatting.label: SHOUTING!!!
emotional.sensational_formatting.why: Caps and exclamation marks sell arousal, not information.

interpersonal.flattery_love_bombing.label: Flattery
interpersonal.flattery_love_bombing.why: Personal flattery from a company that cannot know you.

interpersonal.negging.label: Negging
interpersonal.negging.why: Lowers your status so buying restores it.

interpersonal.isolation_distrust_others.label: 'Trust only us'
interpersonal.isolation_distrust_others.why: Tells you to distrust every other source.

interpersonal.future_faking.label: Future promises
interpersonal.future_faking.why: 'Coming soon' keeps you paying for nothing checkable.

interpersonal.darvo_victim_reversal.label: Victim reversal
interpersonal.darvo_victim_reversal.why: The accused becomes the victim; the question is never answered.

interpersonal.gaslighting_markers.label: Gaslighting
interpersonal.gaslighting_markers.why: Denies the record so you doubt your memory.

interpersonal.hoovering_winback.label: Cancel pressure
interpersonal.hoovering_winback.why: Guilt and sudden discounts when you try to cancel.

interpersonal.cult_community.label: 'Join the movement'
interpersonal.cult_community.why: Belonging language makes doubt feel like betrayal.

interpersonal.manufactured_enemy.label: Manufactured enemy
interpersonal.manufactured_enemy.why: An outside enemy is named to bind the group.

interpersonal.foot_in_door.label: Small first ask
interpersonal.foot_in_door.why: A tiny yes makes the big ask feel consistent.

bias.anchoring_price_compare.label: 'Was' price

bias.anchoring_strikethrough.label: Crossed-out price
bias.anchoring_strikethrough.why: Reference prices are often never actually charged.

bias.bnpl.label: Pay later
bias.bnpl.why: Instalments make the total price easier to overlook.

bias.decoy_tier_badge.label: 'Most popular' tier
bias.decoy_tier_badge.why: The highlighted plan is the one they want to sell.

bias.free_with_conditions.label: Conditions on 'free'
bias.free_with_conditions.why: Free trial business models run on people who forget.

bias.monthly_display_annual_billing.label: Yearly bill
bias.monthly_display_annual_billing.why: You'll pay twelve times the headline, at once.

bias.hidden_fees.label: Fees at checkout
bias.hidden_fees.why: Mandatory fees revealed after you've invested effort.

bias.sunk_cost_progress.label: 'Almost there'
bias.sunk_cost_progress.why: The step you're hurried through is the costly one.

bias.reciprocity_gift.label: Free gift
bias.reciprocity_gift.why: An unasked-for gift creates an urge to repay.

bias.default_optout_language.label: Auto-renew / opt-out
bias.default_optout_language.why: Whatever is pre-set stays set unless you change it.

bias.exclusivity_access.label: Exclusive / waitlist

claims.asterisked_claim.label: Asterisk claim
claims.asterisked_claim.why: The * means the headline isn't true as written.

claims.unlimited_hedge.label: 'Unlimited' hedge

claims.guarantee_puffery.label: Guarantee
claims.guarantee_puffery.why: A refund promise; check its conditions and deadline.

claims.grandiosity_puffery.label: Superlatives
claims.grandiosity_puffery.why: 'Revolutionary' is unprovable and carries no information.

claims.health_cure.label: Miracle cure
claims.health_cure.why: Cure/detox language is a regulator red flag.

claims.financial_promises.label: Get-rich promise
claims.financial_promises.why: Specific income figures with no audited basis.

claims.fake_trust_signals.label: Trust words
claims.fake_trust_signals.why: A trust claim with no named source to check.

claims.results_disclaimer.label: 'Results may vary'
claims.results_disclaimer.why: The fine print admits the testimonial isn't typical.

claims.authority_credentials_vague.label: 'Doctor recommended'
claims.authority_credentials_vague.why: Which doctors, how many, who paid?

dark.confirmshaming.label: Confirmshaming
dark.confirmshaming.why: The 'no' is worded to make you feel stupid.

dark.trick_question.label: Trick question

dark.forced_registration.label: Sign-up wall
dark.forced_registration.why: Harvests your data as the price of entry.

dark.sneak_into_basket.label: Sneaked add-on

dark.cancellation_friction.label: Hard to cancel

dark.bait_switch_unavailable.label: Bait and switch
dark.bait_switch_unavailable.why: The deal vanished; the alternative costs more.

dark.preselection.label: Pre-checked box
dark.preselection.why: Most people never untick a default.

dark.disguised_ads.label: Ads as content

dark.content_gate.label: Content gate
dark.content_gate.why: Teaser first, wall after you're invested.

dark.no_cancel_path.label: No cancel info

dark.interrupting_overlay.label: Pop-up interruption

dark.exit_intent_popup.label: Exit-intent pop-up

design.asymmetric_choice.label: Buried 'no'

design.red_urgency.why: Red makes marketing read as a warning.

design.animated_cta.label: Pulsing button

charts.inverted_axis.label: Inverted axis

charts.truncated_bar_axis.label: Truncated axis

charts.unlabeled_log_scale.label: Hidden log scale

charts.short_window.label: Short time window
charts.short_window.why: Zoom out; the long run may say the opposite.

charts.few_points.label: Few data points
charts.few_points.why: A trend through four points is fragile.

charts.pie.label: Pie chart
charts.pie.why: Angles are hard to compare; check they sum to 100%.

charts.flat_aspect.label: Flattened chart
charts.flat_aspect.why: Wide and short makes change look small.

charts.tall_aspect.label: Stretched chart

charts.no_axis_titles.label: No units

charts.svg_chart_ok.label: Chart checked

charts.canvas_chart.label: Chart (uninspectable)

charts.embedded_chart.label: Embedded chart

charts.image_chart.label: Chart image
